notice.title: LLM model configuration (built-in + BYOK)
notice.description: Two ways to connect models: the built-in model is maintained by the platform admin (key and available models are managed centrally, all tenants use it directly without bringing their own key); BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) lets each tenant's admin/operator configure their own model key, effective for that tenant only. When no model is configured, the system falls back to the LITELLM_MODEL environment variable (if set).

effective.title: Currently effective model
effective.notConfigured: No model is configured; AI capabilities run in rule-based fallback mode.

builtin.title: Built-in model (platform-wide)
builtin.description: Maintained by the platform admin: configure once, all tenants use it directly. Keys are sealed with envelope encryption server-side; no list or detail view ever echoes them.

byok.title: My BYOK (this tenant)
byok.description: Configure your own model key, effective for this tenant only. Takes precedence over the built-in model; editable by tenant admin and operator.
